spec.claim_summary: A 5-period EMA crossing the 50-period EMA together with 5-period RSI crossing 50 on bar close generates a signal.
assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim says 'crosses' with no long/short direction, implying both bullish and bearish signals, but schema allows only long or short; compiled long-side only (5EMA crosses above 50EMA and RSI crosses above 50) as closest testable core, short side omitted.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: no exit was stated and schema requires an exit; opposite cross (5EMA crosses below 50EMA) used as placeholder exit, not from claimant.
Chose timeframe 1d from the two stated options (daily and 4 hour charts); 4h variant not tested.
Waiting for the candle to close matches the engine's bar-close evaluation.
Assets are spot forex outside the bundled Binance universe; kept testable, engine will report lack of data.

evidence.quote: on USD/CAD, EUR/USD, GBP/USD, and also EUR/JPY
on the daily and 4 hour charts

audit_majors: direction: Claim says '5ema crosses your 50ema and RSI cross the 50 line' with no long/short qualifier, implying both bullish and bearish signals. Spec encodes long-only (crosses_above) and omits short side.
exit[0]: No exit was stated in claim. Spec invents 5EMA crosses_below 50EMA as exit, which controls holding period and was not from claimant.
